body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Bamboo Technology introduced ''Vault 360'', a file sharing software for portable devices.

The software converts and transfers music, movies, and pictures to and from many portable devices: smartphones, cell phones, cameras, PDAs, MP3 players and more. As for now, it will work between 7,000 portable devices and the number will increase even as you read this article. The price ranges from 29.99 USD (combo version) to 49.99 (complete version).
